frequency_question: How often do central bank liquidity tool announcements fall precisely within a targeted future date window given that the policy intent exists?
membership_rule: Includes official central bank circulars, notifications, or press releases regarding targeted liquidity instruments; excludes general monetary policy committee rate announcements unless specifically addressing the named tool within the window.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major targeted liquidity measure rollouts examined
known_gaps: Minor operational tweaks via standard daily liquidity operations are excluded by definition.
skeleton: named cases of targeted liquidity announcements over the past regulatory cycles
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 relevant historical implementations matching formal notification criteria
validity_reason: Central bank communication protocols and regulatory notification procedures change slowly over decades.
